DB_TIMEOUT.meaning: The application could not acquire a database connection before its timeout.
DB_TIMEOUT.likely_cause: Possible database connection-pool exhaustion. A saturated pool explains the timeouts, but this log cannot show why the connections stayed busy.
other_hypotheses: Connections not returned to the pool
next_checks: Compare active connections and wait times with traffic
Inspect slow queries and open transactions
Check that connections are released on both success and error paths
